- Refactored `Effect` class to use centralized queueing instead of immediate execution on invalidation
- Created full `SignalDispatcher` implementation with batching, cycle detection, idempotent registration, and test utilities
- Added `UI.init()` method to register the dispatcher, with automatic registration on class load
- Updated all existing reactive tests to call `SignalDispatcher.flush()` after modifying signal values
- Added comprehensive unit tests for `SignalDispatcher` and updated `EffectTest` for test isolation

- Added formal specification documentation for the signal dispatcher system in openspec/

- Add re-entrancy guard to VirtualContainer.layout() to avoid recursive layout and reconciliation calls
- Memoize ChatStore.user() computed instances per user ID to eliminate orphaned computed subscriptions
- Implement equals() and hashCode() on GroupedMessageItem for proper value equality checks
- Update existing specs and add comprehensive new spec documentation, task lists, and proposal docs for the changes
